function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH first_click AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_click_time
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_click_events AS (
    SELECT 
        a.session,
        a.stamp,
        a.path,
        a.search_type,
        MIN(CASE WHEN a.path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN a.stamp END) OVER (PARTITION BY a.session) as first_click_time
    FROM activity_log a
    WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != ''
)
SELECT 
    pre_click.session,
    pre_click.stamp,
    pre_click.path,
    pre_click.search_type
FROM pre_click_events pre_click
WHERE pre_click.stamp < pre_click.first_click_time
ORDER BY pre_click.session, pre_click.stamp
LIMIT 30", "preview_rows": 20}

{"sql": "WITH first_click AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_click_time
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_click_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        f.session,
        COUNT(*) as pre_click_count
    FROM first_click f
    INNER JOIN activity_log a ON a.session = f.session
    WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != ''
    AND a.stamp < f.first_click_time
    GROUP BY f.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_c
    FROM pre_click_counts
)
SELECT 
    pcc.session,
    pcc.pre_click_count,
    a.path,
    a.search_type
FROM pre_click_counts pcc
INNER JOIN min_count mc ON pcc.pre_click_count = mc.min_c
INNER JOIN activity_log a ON a.session = pcc.session
    AND a.search_type IS NOT NULL AND a.search_type != ''
    AND a.stamp < (
        SELECT first_click_time FROM first_click WHERE session = pcc.session
    )
ORDER BY pcc.session, a.stamp", "preview_rows": 30}
